name: time_get
description: Read the phone's clock: the local time, date and time zone.

name: volume_set
description: Set a volume on the phone to a percentage. Use stream media unless the owner names another (ring, alarm, notification, call).

name: volume_step
description: Turn a volume on the phone one step up or down (about a tenth of its range). Use stream media unless the owner names another.

name: media_control
description: Control whatever media is playing on the phone (music, podcasts, audiobooks).

name: end_turn
description: End the conversation when the owner is done (they say thanks, that's all, bye, or similar). Say goodbye briefly first if it fits.
